quote: The commissioning ceremony for the Piarco International Airport Solar Park Project, the first centralized photovoltaic project undertaken by POWERCHINA in Trinidad and Tobago, was held on July 30, marking the official commencement of the project's operations. … Located at Piarco International Airport, it involves the construction of a 518.84-kilowatt solar photovoltaic power station, including design, procurement, construction and commissioning. … The Piarco International Airport Solar Park Project will generate at least 767,034 kilowatt-hours of electricity annually
note: Opened POWERCHINA English release 1 Aug 2024 (Piarco 518.84 kW COD).
